description: This file is a shell script used for testing git submodule fetch behaviors, including recursive fetches, configuration overrides, and submodule updates under various scenarios.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Writes the expected output for a submodule fetch into an error file, given new and super commit hashes.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Writes the expected output for a second submodule fetch into an error file, given new and super commit hashes.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Outputs expected fetch response for a deep submodule, given commit hashes.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Outputs expected fetch response for the main superproject.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Creates new commits in submodules and writes expected fetch output files.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Updates submodules and superproject commits, generating expected fetch outputs.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies that the actual fetch error output matches the expected output, concatenating multiple expected files.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files and pushes to the remote repository.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares two refs in different directories to verify they point to identical commits.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Performs a fetch with sed-processed output to prevent infinite recursion bugs in submodule fetches.
